10→It has been submitted on behalf of the petitioner that petitioner is owner of the

Masjid, Gomti Nagar, Tehsil and District Lucknow and had applied for an 
electricity connection of 2 KW load before the opposite party no.4.

the documents in this regard but till date electricity connection has not been 
granted to the petitioner.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of MVVNL submitted that there is some 
information that the said property is disputed property.
We se see no reason that why even if the property is disputed property, 
20→respondents can decline to grant electricity connection in the said premises.  
At the best they can take an indemnity bond even if the petitioner is not owner 
of the said premises as per provisions of Annexure 4.2 of the Electricity 
Supply Code, 2005.
Accordingly, opposite party no.4 is directed to intimate the petitioner to all the 
documents required to be submitted within one week from the date a certified 
copy of this order is produced before him.  The petitioner undertakes to supply 
all the documents within next three days and in case he complies with the 
direction of opposite party no.4, respondent no.4 shall proceed to grant an 
electricity connection no later than one week thereafter in accordance with 
30→law.
